title: UFOs seen on Pine Ridge Reservation
place_text: Pine Ridge Indian Reservation, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I saw one I saw two on Pine Ridge.

plain: Michael Johnson, a US Air Force veteran who says he was once abducted by aliens, recalls seeing UFOs in the 1970s on the Pine Ridge Indian Reservation, a Native American reservation in South Dakota. In his words, he saw one, then two, there. He tells it as part of a wider history of strange encounters in his life.
